scope: Offline fit, timing and synthetic interface validation; no device acceptance
backend: Independent CRAM1 using native 100.663296 MHz clock and upstream asynchronous CellRAM driver; synchronized APF upload/control

raster.scope: Calibrated RAM plus synthetic pin-level CellRAM; test-only reference signed-clipping correction

actual_components: licensed Intel FIFO and RAM models
boot.scope: Visible first native-rate raster and key starts actual animation; default probe does not complete eight sequential animation frames

lifecycle: Synthetic controller checks cover A/B/wrap, three launches, ordinary saves, RTC, pause, failed-flush state retention, unsafe paths and stale completion
historical_failure: GBA .5 failed on hardware and is blocked from publication; exact original cause unconfirmed
physical_limit: Behavioral peripheral model, FPGA-side constraints and synthetic files do not establish board timing, all-game compatibility or save durability

clock_scope.static_timing: Actual generated/quantized clocks in the full compiled design
